newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gas Natural sees 96 profit near 50 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Gas Natural sees 96 profit near 50 bln ptas.

text.p: Spain's Gas Natural chairman said on Sunday net profit for 1996 would continue the trend seen in the first nine months of the year and come in at around 50 billion pesetas.
"The results to September improved by 33 percent and for the end of the year it will be around 50 billion pesetas," Pedro Duran said at a news conference.
The energy group posted 33.55 billion peseta net consolidated profit for the first nine months of this year.

Duran said the company's new gas pipeline stretching from North Africa to Europe would be an important focus for the company in the future. After a 2.3 billion dollar investment the line is expected to supply 50 percent of the company's gas bought abroad by the year 2000, he said.
He said the pipeline would eventually be extended to central Europe although a concrete plan had not yet been developed.
Duran added that half the company's 500 billion peseta investment between 1996 and 2000 would be directed towards distribution, 150 billion to transport and 50 billion toward developing storage.
"This will be achieved without touching the company's capital and will be self-financed," Duran said.
